name: B10-0057/2025 (PPE) – Need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the European Union and other countries to reject Belarus's presidential election on 26 January 2025 and to keep refusing to recognise Aliaksandr Lukashenka as president. It asks for sanctions on people and groups running the election campaign, for the release of over 1,500 political prisoners, and for support for exiled Belarusians and the democratic opposition. It also accuses the Belarusian leadership of helping Russia's war against Ukraine. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- The European Union and its member states are urged to reject the election result and not recognise Lukashenka as president.
- Sanctions are requested against people and groups organising the election campaign, including the Federation of Trade Unions of Belarus.
- The European Union is asked to support political prisoners, exiled Belarusians and the opposition led by Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya.
